![Forever Mail Courier logo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paradosi/ForeverCourier/main/media/art/logo_400.png)

# Forever Mail Courier

**Mails your crafting materials to the alts who use them.** Herbs to your alchemist, leather to
your leatherworker, cloth to your tailor: set it up once, and at any mailbox one button sends
everything in your bags to the right character, 12 items to a letter.

For **WoW Forever** only.

## Features

- **Category rules.** One recipient per Trade Goods category: Herbs, Cloth, Leather,
  Metal & Stone, Enchanting, Elemental, Cooking, Parts, Other.
- **Item rules** override the category: *Iron Ore → the engineer* even though Metal & Stone goes to
  the blacksmith, or **keep** to never send an item (keep your Mageroyal for your own potions).
- **Suggested from your professions.** With [Forever Alts](https://github.com/paradosi/ForeverAlts)
  installed, the first login fills every empty category from the professions it has recorded. If
  several characters share a profession, the highest skill gets it.
- **A panel beside the mail window** shows who would get what (letters, item count, the items as
  icons) before anything is sent.
- **Send all** mails it one letter after the other. Each letter's subject lists what's in it
  ("Peacebloom x40, Silverleaf x20"). It stops and says why if a letter is refused, the mailbox
  closes or you run out of postage.
- **Never sent:** soulbound items, quest items, locked slots, and anything whose rule names the
  character you're playing.
- **Tooltip line** on every item with a rule: *Courier: to Vex Cairn (category)*.
- wowdb.dev's look (navy, gold, Oswald and JetBrains Mono), no libraries.
- **Help and bug reports:** the rules window shows the installed version, and its **Help** button gives you the GitHub address to copy.

## Requirements

- WoW Forever (interface 16001).
- Optional: Forever Alts, for the suggestions and the ▾ list of your characters.
- Gold for postage: the game charges per attachment (shown in the Send Mail tab).

## Install

From [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/projects/1834692) or [Wago](https://addons.wago.io/addons/rN4rqwKD)
with your addon manager, or copy the folder into
`World of Warcraft\_forever_\Interface\AddOns\ForeverCourier` (the folder keeps the name
`ForeverCourier`), or from this repo: `wowdev deploy ForeverCourier --flavor forever`.

## Usage

1. `/courier` (or the addon compartment) opens **Courier Rules**.
2. Type a character's name in each category you want sent, or pick one from **▾**. **Suggest**
   fills the empty ones from Forever Alts. Leave a row empty and that category stays in your bags.
3. For single items, drag the item onto the **+** slot, type a name or `keep`, and press **Add**.
4. Open any mailbox. The **Courier** panel to the right of the mail window lists what would go.
   Press **Send all**. Press **Stop** to stop between letters.

### Examples

| You want | Rule |
|---|---|
| Every herb to your alchemist | Herbs → `Vex Cairn` |
| Ore to the blacksmith, but Copper Ore to the engineer | Metal & Stone → `Vex Warden`; item Copper Ore → `Kai Lu` |
| Silverleaf stays with whoever gathered it | item Silverleaf → `keep` |
| Vials to the alchemist (they're in "Other") | item Empty Vial → `Vex Cairn` |

On your blacksmith, his own Metal & Stone rule names him, so his ore stays put. The panel notes
"N stacks are for this character: kept."

### Slash commands

| Command | Does |
|---|---|
| `/courier` | Open or close the rules window |
| `/courier send` | Send all (at a mailbox) |
| `/courier stop` | Stop after the current letter |
| `/courier item [item] Name` | Item rule. Shift-click the item into chat for the link, or give its ID. `keep` or `clear` instead of a name |
| `/courier panel` | Turn the mailbox panel off or on |
| `/courier tooltip` | Turn the tooltip line off or on |
| `/courier minimap` | Show or hide the minimap button |
| `/courier help` | The version, the GitHub link and the commands |

The **minimap button** opens the rules on left-click and, on right-click, prints what your bags would send now
(who, how many items, how many letters). Drag it around the edge to move it. The tick at the bottom of the rules
window shows or hides it.

## Configuration

Saved account-wide in `ForeverCourierDB`, so every character uses the same rules.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `categories[subclassID]` | empty | Recipient for that Trade Goods subclass |
| `items[itemID]` | empty | Recipient for one item, or `false` = keep |
| `settings.panel` | `true` | Show the panel at the mailbox |
| `settings.tooltip` | `true` | The *Courier:* line on item tooltips |
| `settings.minimap` | `true` | Show the minimap button |
| `settings.minimapAngle` | `265` | Where the button sits on the minimap's edge, in degrees |
| `suggested` | unset | Set once the first-login suggestion has run |

## How it works

**Routing** (`Rules.lua`). An item rule wins. Otherwise, if the item is Trade Goods (class 7),
the rule for its subclass applies. The subclass IDs are Forever's own, checked against wowdb.dev's
copy of the game data:

| Subclass | Category | Examples | Suggested profession |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9 | Herbs | Peacebloom, Purple Lotus | Alchemy |
| 5 | Cloth | Linen Cloth, Coarse Thread | Tailoring |
| 6 | Leather | Light Leather, Salt | Leatherworking |
| 7 | Metal & Stone | Copper Ore, Iron Bar, Rough Stone | Blacksmithing, then Engineering |
| 12 | Enchanting | Strange Dust, Lesser Magic Essence | Enchanting |
| 10 | Elemental | Elemental Fire, Heart of Fire | Alchemy, then Blacksmithing |
| 8 | Cooking | Stringy Wolf Meat, Raw Brilliant Smallfish | Cooking |
| 1 | Parts | Wooden Stock | Engineering |
| 11 | Other | Empty Vial, dyes, Strong Flux, gems | none |

`ns.Plan()` walks the backpack, the four bags and the reagent bag, and groups every routable slot
by recipient.

**Sending** (`Send.lua`). Each step plans again from the bags, so a letter that went out simply
isn't in the next plan:

1. Switch the mail window to Send Mail. Blizzard tells the server the send frame is hidden while
   the Inbox tab shows, so attachments need it.
2. Refuse if the Send Mail tab already holds items. That's a letter you're writing, and it would
   go to the wrong person.
3. Attach the first recipient's slots, up to 12: pick up, then `ClickSendMailItemButton(i)`.
4. Wait for them to register, then check the postage against your gold.
5. Zero the money and C.O.D., then `SendMail(name, subject)` directly. Blizzard's own Send button
   would read the To and Subject boxes, which the addon leaves alone.
6. `MAIL_SEND_SUCCESS` → pause 0.6 s → next step. `MAIL_FAILED` (with the reason from
   `UI_ERROR_MESSAGE`), `MAIL_CLOSED` or 15 s without an answer ends the run with a message.

**Names.** Forever names are *First Last* and there are no realms. Names are compared ignoring
case, extra spaces and hyphens, and stored capitalised ("kai lu" → "Kai Lu").

## Design decisions

- **Categories plus item rules, not recipe reagents.** Routing by "whichever alt has a recipe that
  uses it" is more exact, but works only once each alt has opened its profession window. Forever
  Alts doesn't record reagents yet either. Categories work on day one, and an item rule fixes any
  case they get wrong.
- **One button, not automatic.** Sending on opening the mailbox is faster, but mailing your
  materials away by accident is worse than one click. The panel shows everything before it goes.
- **A standalone addon, not a Forever Alts tab.** It reads Forever Alts' saved data when present
  and works without it.
- **Plan again after every letter**, instead of planning once and working through a list. Bags
  change while letters go out (stacks move, loot arrives), and a stale list would attach the
  wrong slots.
- **Never touch a letter in progress.** If the Send Mail tab holds anything, the run doesn't
  start.
- **No libraries.** The panel, buttons and window are a few hundred lines on `Theme.lua`. Ace or
  LibDBIcon would add more than they save.

## Confirmed in game

Settled at a real mailbox on WoW Forever (2026-11-27), where the headless test could only simulate:

- `SendMail` accepts *First Last* names typed with a space, the way the To box does.
- Forever lets `SendMail` run from a timer, so **Send all** sends every letter from one press.
- Postage is read from `GetSendMailPrice()` before each letter, so whatever Forever charges is what the addon checks against your gold.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause / fix |
|---|---|
| "the Send Mail tab already holds items" | Send or clear the letter you were writing, then Send all again |
| "the letter to X was refused: Cannot find player" | The name in the rule is misspelled. Fix it in `/courier` |
| "… mailbox is full" | The recipient has 100 letters waiting. Log them in and empty it |
| Panel missing | You closed it with ×, which hides it until the next mailbox. Use the small courier button on the mail window's right edge, or `/courier panel` if it's turned off |
| Suggest is greyed out | Forever Alts isn't installed, or hasn't recorded your characters yet (log each one in once) |
| An item isn't sent | Soulbound, a quest item, outside Trade Goods with no item rule, or its rule names the character you're on. Its tooltip line says where it would go |

## Development

```sh
./check ForeverCourier            # the static gate (from ~/projects/wowaddons)
lua5.1 tests/smoke.lua            # from ForeverCourier/: the headless run
wowdev deploy ForeverCourier --flavor forever
```

| File | Holds |
|---|---|
| `Core.lua` | Saved data, names, events, slash command, Forever Alts reader |
| `Rules.lua` | Categories, routing, suggestions, the plan, the tooltip line |
| `Send.lua` | The send loop and the server's answers |
| `MailUI.lua` | The panel beside the mail window |
| `RulesUI.lua` | The rules window |
| `Theme.lua` | wowdb.dev's colours, fonts and widgets (from FarmMode Forever) |
| `tests/smoke.lua` | Stubbed API and simulated mail server |

releases.notes:
# Changelog

## v1.0.0

- First release, for WoW Forever. Set who gets each kind of crafting material (Herbs, Cloth, Leather,
  Metal & Stone, Enchanting, Elemental, Cooking, Parts, Other), or single items, or keep an item.
- With Forever Alts installed, your characters' professions fill in the rules for you.
- At a mailbox, a panel beside the mail window shows what would go to whom, and **Send all** mails
  it, 12 items per letter.
- Soulbound and quest items are never sent, nor anything addressed to the character you're on.
- Item tooltips say where the item would be sent.
- **Minimap button**: left-click opens or closes the rules, right-click lists what your bags would send and to
  whom, drag it around the edge. Turn it off with the tick at the bottom of the rules window or `/courier minimap`.
- The rules window shows the version and has a **Help** button with the GitHub address to copy; `/courier help` prints both
